vanillashader.configuration.title: Vanilla Shader
vanillashader.config.profile.tooltip: Low: color grading, haze and simple water. Medium: adds reflections, bloom, ambient occlusion, god rays and sun shadows. High/Max: more samples and longer, sharper shadows. Custom: pick every effect yourself.
vanillashader.config.custom.tooltip: Per-effect quality, used when the profile is Custom.
vanillashader.config.ambient_occlusion.t: Soft shadows in corners and under blocks.
vanillashader.config.reflections.tooltip: Low reflects only the sky and sun; Medium and up also reflect terrain on screen.
vanillashader.config.god_rays.tooltip: Light shafts from the sun through trees and terrain.
vanillashader.config.shadows.tooltip: Shadows cast by terrain, trees and buildings, also from off screen. High and up add fine contact shadows.
vanillashader.config.look.tooltip: Image adjustments applied on every profile.
vanillashader.config.warmth.tooltip: Golden tint at sunrise/sunset and cool tint at night.
vanillashader.config.atmosphere.tooltip: Strength of the sunlit haze over distant terrain.
vanillashader.config.weather_integration: With WeatherStory installed, clouds and storms dim god rays, glare and sun reflections. With Sodium, WeatherStory's cloud shadows are drawn on the terrain as part of the sun shadows.
vanillashader.config.upscaling.tooltip: Render the world at a lower resolution and upscale it with AMD FSR 1. Set per profile; the HUD and hand always stay sharp.
vanillashader.config.render_scale.toolti: Resolution the world is rendered at for this profile before AMD FSR 1 upscales it to your screen. Lower is faster but softer.
vanillashader.config.fsr_sharpness.toolt: Strength of FSR's sharpening (RCAS) after upscaling.
vanillashader.config.fsr_enabled.tooltip: Turn FSR 1 upscaling on or off. When off, every profile renders at native resolution and the render scales below are ignored.
vanillashader.config.dynamic_lights.tool: Torches, lanterns, glowstone and other light sources light up their surroundings with smooth, coloured light: held by players and mobs, lying on the ground or placed in the world. Glowing mobs light the world too, as bright as they glow: the Warden's heartbeat, a creeper about to explode, Enderman eyes, Blazes, glow squids, fireballs and more.
vanillashader.config.reset_look.tooltip: Put every slider on this page back to its default value.
vanillashader.config.reset_look.confirm: Put exposure, saturation, contrast, warmth, atmosphere, water reflectivity and vignette back to their defaults?
